result.title: TwoPass: Draft-Guided Few-Step Video Prediction for Robotic Manipulation
result.summary: Action-conditioned video prediction lets robots anticipate the visual consequences of their actions for planning and policy evaluation. Existing predictors denoise each future from noise without using their own estimate of it, which limits the quality of the predicted future, in particular of the manipulated objects, and requires many network calls. We present TwoPass, a self-conditioned training-and-inference framework that keeps the standard flow-matching objective. Self-Generated Draft Training supplies a detached clean-video estimate from the shared network as conditioning at the same noisy state. A Refinement-Only Late Adapter applies a dedicated residual transformation when a draft is present. At inference, Draft-Reuse Iterative Refinement obtains both a solver update and the next draft from each velocity prediction, requiring as few as 4 function evaluations (NFE) per video chunk. Training samples discrete solver-query noise levels and updates the pretrained backbone. Extensive experiments on Bridge and Language Table show that TwoPass achieves state-of-the-art results with 4 NFE, far fewer than the 50-59 calls of existing predictors. Code: https://github.com/PlantPotatoOnMoon/TwoPass.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 TwoPass，一个自条件的训练与推理框架：训练时用共享网络产生的干净视频估计作为同一噪声状态下的条件，并加入仅在存在草稿时激活的残差适配器；推理时每次速度预测同时给出求解器更新与下一个草稿，使每个视频片段只需 4 次函数评估，在 Bridge 与 Language Table 上取得较优结果。
AI.relevance_reason: 草稿复用式迭代细化与少步计算预算，可能为 LVR 中 latent 状态的循环更新、自条件复用及「多想几步是否值得」的成本权衡提供可供核查的方法线索；但论文本身研究机器人动作条件下的视频预测，不直接涉及视觉推理。
